title: Introduce delegated tenant bootstrapper and namespace constraint enforcer for safe RBAC rollouts
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds a delegated tenant bootstrap operator and a CRD-based namespace constraint enforcer to enable safer RBAC rollouts and reversible tenant migrations for Private deployments.
description:
Context: Private deployments require frequent RBAC updates during tenant onboarding and migration. Past rollouts that applied cluster-wide seed roles caused accidental cross-tenant bindings during large upgrades. This PR introduces a delegated bootstrap operator plus a lightweight constraint enforcer to limit role/rolebinding creation to tenant-scoped namespaces, and to allow operators to run with minimal cluster privileges.

What this PR does: - Adds a new 'delegated-tenant-bootstrapper' operator that performs bootstrap actions via a short-lived delegation token instead of requiring full cluster-admin credentials. The operator can be run as part of the private-installer or independently. - Introduces a NamespaceConstraint CRD (namespace-constraint-enforcer) that validates RoleBinding subjects and disallows cluster-scoped privileged RoleBindings originating from tenant-bootstrap flows. - Helm charts: new values for enableDelegatedBootstrap, delegationTTL, and constraintEnforcer.enabled; templates updated to render a ServiceAccount with minimal RBAC and a Role that limits scope to tenant namespaces. - Terraform: module updates to generate the delegation IAM role and store delegation metadata in state for safe rollbacks. - Migration and rollback playbooks and preflight checks to ensure no tenant loses access during upgrade.

Why: The delegated pattern reduces blast radius of bootstrap operations and supports air-gapped/private installs where operator credentials are rotated frequently. The constraint enforcer provides an automated guardrail so that scripted provisioning can't create cross-tenant bindings even if a template bug exists.

Checklist (tested/verified): - [x] Operator unit tests for delegation flow and token renewal. - [x] Integration tests with helm chart rendering for both enabled and disabled paths. - [x] E2E upgrade test in CI (staged cluster) with tenant migration and rollback scenario. - [x] Terraform plan output reviewed to ensure no drift in existing resources. - [x] Rollback playbook executed against a canary tenant (manual dry runs recorded).

Migration notes: To adopt the delegated path, operators should set values.enableDelegatedBootstrap=true and provide a delegation role ARN (or local K8s-bound token for on-prem). The installer will create a short-lived delegation token and annotate tenant namespaces with the bootstrap session id. When rolling back, the rollback playbook will revoke delegation tokens and re-apply previous rolebindings from the saved plan.

Security considerations: - Delegation tokens are short-lived (configurable default 10m). - The operator's ServiceAccount is bound to a Role that only has create/patch/list on Role/RoleBinding in tenant namespaces. - The enforcer runs as an admission webhook validating RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding create/update requests; webhook is optional and can be disabled via helm values for constrained environments.

Related work: ENG-1459 (delegated bootstrapping design doc), ENG-1478 (namespace constraints proposal), SUP-8921 (customer report describing cross-tenant role leak during upgrade).

review_comments: Jing Li: Can we parameterize the default delegation TTL? Some air-gapped customers require longer-lived tokens (commented inline at charts/values.yaml).
Aisha Patel: Replied - added delegationTTL with a safe default of 10m and documented the security trade-offs (see docs/private/delegated-bootstrap.md).
Connor Hughes: Requested change - webhook should have a 'fail-closed' vs 'fail-open' configuration flag; don't default to fail-closed for older clusters to avoid outages.
Aisha Patel: Addressed - added helm value constraintEnforcer.failMode with default 'fail-open' and added migration step to flip to 'fail-closed' after validation.
merge_commit_summary:
Squashed commit of the following:
- feat(operator): add delegated bootstrap controller and token lifecycle
- feat(crd): introduce NamespaceConstraint CRD
- chore(helm): new values and templates
- infra(terraform): delegation role and outputs
- test/docs: e2e, migration guide
notes_on_upgrade: Preflight: run `make preflight-delegation` which validates namespace annotations and terraform state before enabling the operator.
Canary: enable on a single tenant and verify RoleBinding creation is limited to that tenant's namespace before rolling out globally.
Rollback: use docs/private/rollback-playbook.md; the playbook revokes active delegation sessions and re-applies previous RoleBindings from saved plan.json.
post_merge_actions: Publish migration guide to Operations channel and update KB for SUP-8921
Schedule follow-up: ENG-1510 for metrics (delegation token usage) and ENG-1526 for HSM-backed delegation in on-prem installs
